key.name: balanced-push
key.description: Use equal pointer-hotspot insets on all four sides in full-screen Push mode. Other tracking modes and lenses retain GNOME behavior.

key.name: push-margin
key.description: Distance from each visible edge in logical pixels at which panning starts. Independent of zoom. Zero requires reaching the edge; large values are capped at 45 percent of each viewport dimension.

key.name: low-latency-pointer
key.description: Refresh magnifier tracking before rendered frames on older GNOME. GNOME 51's native event-driven tracking takes precedence; this setting has no effect there.

key.name: zoom-sensitivity
key.description: Exponential zoom amount per scroll unit.

key.name: smoothing-ms
key.description: Time in milliseconds to cover about 95% of the requested change. Zero disables interpolation.
